blocks.text: The legal counsel of Korina Sanchez, Ruffa Gutierrez, John Estrada and Cristina Gonzalez informed the public that the celebrities had terminated their endorsement ties with BRM Centers OPC and VMP Medical, Inc., which operates VMP Regenerative Clinic. “This public notice is issued today—only after exhausting a full month of private written demands begun on Oct. 13, 2026 under the contract’s good-faith dispute clause-because BRM Centers OPC and VMP Medical, Inc. failed to remove their images privately, exposed them to November cease-and-desist notices from EW Villa Medica Germany, and left the public at risk of relying on unauthorized celebrity endorsements,” read the […]...
